data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (type origin and pick the suggestion, type destination and pick the suggestion, open the date picker, click Find flights) and names nearly the same parameters. It omits the trip_type parameter and the "Book with miles" toggle seen in the actual actions, and it lists a passengers/cabin step the real occurrence didn't perform, but a browser automation could still be built from it.
